title: Dell XPS 16 tanıtıldı: Geniş ekran ve yapay zeka özellikleri
summary: Dell, içerik üreticileri için tasarladığı yeni dizüstü bilgisayarı Dell XPS 16'yı duyurdu. Cihaz 16 inçlik ekranı ve Windows 11 altyapısıyla geliyor.
body:
Geçtiğimiz yıl XPS serisini emekliye ayıran Dell, 2026 itibarıyla bu popüler dizüstü bilgisayar ailesini yeniden kullanıcılarla buluşturdu. XDA-Developers'ın aktardığına göre yeni **Dell XPS 16**, özellikle içerik üreticileri ve kreatif profesyoneller hedef alınarak tasarlandı ve güçlü bileşenleriyle dikkat çekiyor.

## Dell XPS 16 özellikleri ve performans detayları

Cihaz, 16 inçlik 2K LCD ekran seçeneğiyle gelirken isteyen kullanıcılar 3.2K OLED dokunmatik ekrana da geçiş yapabiliyor. Kaputun altında ise 16 çekirdekli Intel Core Ultra X9 işlemciye kadar seçenekler sunuluyor. **Windows 11** işletim sistemiyle çalışan ve Copilot+ özelliklerini barındıran bilgisayar, kullanıcılara uygulama uyumluluğu açısından esneklik sağlıyor.

Bellek ve depolama tarafında ise 64GB'a kadar RAM ve 4TB'a kadar SSD depolama alanıyla yapılandırılabiliyor. Bağlantı özellikleri arasında Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6.0 ve üç adet Thunderbolt 4 bağlantı noktası yer alıyor. Cihaz ayrıca grafit ve parıltılı olmak üzere iki farklı renk seçeneğiyle raflardaki yerini alıyor.

**Neden önemli?** İçerik üreticilerinin taşınabilir cihazlarda ihtiyaç duyduğu geniş ekran alanını ve yüksek işlem gücünü bir araya getiren model, geniş özelleştirme imkanlarıyla farklı iş yüklerine uyum sağlıyor.

source_texts.summary: Last year, Dell retired the XPS name, but now, in 2026, the XPS line of laptops is back and better than ever. The XPS 13, XPS 14, and XPS 16 have all returned, and each meets different needs. But if you’re a creative or content creator? You’ll want to look at the Dell XPS 16 .
source_texts.text:
Last year, Dell retired the XPS name, but now, in 2026, the XPS line of laptops is back and better than ever. The XPS 13, XPS 14, and XPS 16 have all returned, and each meets different needs. But if you’re a creative or content creator? You’ll want to look at the Dell XPS 16.
Everything you want in a portable form
Dell XPS 16 (2026)
- CPU
- Up to Intel® Core Ultra X9 Processor 388H (16- Core, 18MB Cache, up to 5.1 GHz)
- GPU
- Intel graphics (post launch) Intel® Arc graphics
- Display type
- 16-inch 2K
- RAM
- 16GB LPDDR5x Dual Channel at 7467 MT/s 32GB LPDDR5x Dual Channel at 9600 MT/s 64GB LPDDR5x Dual Channel at 9600 MT/s
- Battery
- 70Whr battery (integrated), 900ED cells ExpressCharge 1.0
- Operating System
- Windows 11
If you're a creative looking for a portable powerhouse, the Dell XPS 16 is it. It has a large 16-inch screen, up to 4TB of storage, and more.
A powerful desktop for content creation is great, but you may want something more flexible, whether as your main device or as an ancillary option to use when you’re not at home. But finding the ideal laptop is far from easy.
Or at least, it usually isn’t, but Dell makes it all easy with the XPS line. With the XPS 16, you’ll get a big LCD or OLED screen, up to 4TB of storage, and 64GB of RAM, and the amount of customizability you need to make sure you have the powerful components you need, and not pay for the ones you don’t.
A big, beautiful screen
Anyone who has tried editing photos or video on a laptop screen knows it can get a bit cramped. The XPS 16, true to its name, has a 16-inch, 2K LCD screen, or you can upgrade to a 3.2K OLED touchscreen. Which you’ll want more of depends on exactly what you’re using the laptop for, but a touchscreen is a big plus compared to many other laptop models.
Since many laptops average between 13 and 15 inches — for example, the MacBook Air models are 13 or 15 inches, while the HP OmniBook 14 sits in between at 14 inches. More screen real estate simply means more space to work, and if you’re looking to go portable with your work, you need all the space you can get.
It’s the little things that matter
While this laptop has some fantastic features, small touches also show Dell knows what users need, even beyond the big specs. Take the backlit keyboard, for instance. It’s something you may take for granted, but some modern laptops don’t have it.
A Wi-Fi 7 card and Bluetooth 6.0 card also sound like small upgrades. But the increases in speed and connectivity are great, and for a device that’s meant to be taken everywhere, these wireless upgrades are important. There is even a physical audio jack, so you don’t need to rely on Bluetooth headphones if you’re audio mixing or otherwise tweaking the sound in your content.
If you need to connect to multiple monitors, you can use one of the three Thunderbolt 4 ports (that also have DisplayPort 2.1 functionality) to connect quickly and easily. The number of ports in general is also rare in a laptop — you probably won’t need to carry around a docking station to plug in everything you need with the XPS 16.
The flexibility of Windows 11
The MacBook laptop line might seem like one of the best bets for a creative laptop, but it has the distinct disadvantage of being limited to macOS. A walled-garden OS means that if you need specific apps or something works better on Windows than macOS, you’re simply out of luck. It can also be more difficult to transfer files between operating systems, making the entire process more complicated if you have a Windows desktop.
Dell’s XPS 16 comes with Windows 11 Home and is a Copilot+ laptop, so you’ll have far more flexibility on what apps you can use. This is especially important if your work — creative or otherwise — requires very specific programs to work, such as an internal company app. Most of these apps are designed for Windows only, so a MacBook may not be as versatile if you’re looking for a device that handles everything without issue.
So, other than Apple-exclusive apps, you’ll have every bit of photo and video editing software needed at your fingertips. No workarounds required.
Build the XPS 16 to your needs
Perhaps most importantly, you aren’t locked into one XPS 16 model. On Dell’s website, you can customize the laptop to exactly what you need it to be. That includes the storage, RAM, screen, and more.
With the XPS 16, you can opt for between 512GB and 4TB of SSD storage, and between 8GB and a massive 64GB of DDR5 RAM. Processors can also be upgraded, with four choices in the Series 3 Intel® Core Ultra line, and even the choice to upgrade to Windows 11 Pro. There’s no need for you to compromise with this Dell laptop.
How does the Dell XPS 16 stack up?
